curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: appreciate the importance of word reading in lifelong learning.

mission.title: appreciate the importance of word reading in lifelong learning.

interactions.prompt: Which skill helps you understand a label on a water bottle?
interactions.feedback: Yes! Reading words helps us understand labels.
interactions.retryHint: Think about how letters on a label share meaning.

interactions.prompt: A sign says ‘STOP’. Why is reading it important?
interactions.feedback: Correct! Reading words can guide safe choices.
interactions.retryHint: Think about what the sign tells people to do.

interactions.prompt: Sort where word reading helps and where it does not.

objects.label: checking a medicine label with an adult

interactions.tapAlternative: Tap a situation, then tap its group.
interactions.feedback: Great! Reading supports learning and daily life.
interactions.retryHint: Look for situations that contain written words.

interactions.prompt: Which activity can teach you something new for many years?
interactions.feedback: Well done! Books help us keep learning.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the activity that shares ideas through words.

interactions.prompt: Match each written word to how it helps.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap a word, then tap what it helps us know.
interactions.feedback: Excellent! Reading words helps you act and learn.
interactions.retryHint: Think about the message carried by each word.

interactions.prompt: Why is word reading important throughout life?
choices: It helps us learn and understand messages.
It stops us from asking questions.
interactions.answer: It helps us learn and understand messages.
interactions.feedback: Exactly! Reading opens learning wherever you go.
interactions.retryHint: Think about books, signs and labels.
